summary: Cayson Acquisition Corp, a Nasdaq-listed Cayman SPAC, disclosed that on September 2, 2026 it mutually terminated its July 11, 2025 Agreement and Plan of Merger with Mango Financial Group, North Water Investment Group Holdings and Mango Temp Limited. No price, premium or break fee was stated. Under the Termination Agreement, Mango pays certain Company expenses, and Cayson issues a matching non-interest-bearing promissory note, convertible at Cayson's option into $10.00 private units, mirroring prior Mango notes. The SPAC resumes its initial business combination search; watch trust runway, extension votes, and any replacement target announcement.
